Songscription | Founding Fullstack Engineer | San Francisco, CA | Onsite

At Songscription, we train state-of-the-art AI models to automate music transcription, with the vision of enabling any musician to learn any song, on any instrument, at any difficulty level. We recently raised a $5M funding round to make this possible. (Press release here: https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/songscription-raises-...)

We’re looking for a cracked engineer with a passion for music to join our small, SF-based team and help us build out our consumer product (https://songscription.ai). If you or someone you know wants to work at the intersection of music, AI, and education at a fast-growing startup, please reach out to the co-founders directly at katie (at) songscription (dot) ai or alex (at) songscription (dot) ai.

Full JD here: https://songscription.ai/careers/founding-fullstack-engineer

Other positions available: Part-time designer, content creator, and a marketing lead.
